name: snakeskin_veil_counter_and_hexproof
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains hexproof until end of turn.' Seat 0 casts Snakeskin Veil on its 2/2. The opponent then tries to cast Scorching Dragonfire at that creature: it has hexproof, so it is no legal target of a spell an opponent controls (CR 702.11b), and the cast is refused (the creature, card:1, is off the target population).
